forecast.author: MIST
forecast.method: Each median is the unit-normalized consensus (ESPN, Sleeper, CBS, FantasyPros, FFToday and the sportsbook props where posted; all five sources returned this week) times the tier median from the residual library, with the 50 and 90 widths from the tier quantiles. Hand moves stay on probation (closing line value sign agreement 0.451 on 51 moves), so no median leaves its anchor; the one shaped line is Kenneth Walker III, a questionable mixture at 0.73 to play. Season 50% coverage 0.48 on 136 lines, no slice alarm, so no width change. The pending Devaughn Vele claim (for Keon Coleman, Wed 2:00 AM) is not on the roster and is not in these lines.
